projects.name: Interactive Network Portfolio Interface
projects.description: Modular, event-driven portfolio interface built from scratch. Features a boot terminal, animated particle network, JSON-driven overlay system, and multi-phase UX flow. Deployed as a fully static site on GitHub Pages with zero dependencies.

projects.name: Home Lab Security Environment
projects.description: Isolated virtualized network built for practical cybersecurity testing. Includes a firewall layer, vulnerable target machines, and a monitoring node. Used for practicing enumeration, packet analysis, and defensive hardening techniques.

projects.name: Incident Response Simulation
projects.description: Simulated enterprise IR workflow including log collection, suspicious process identification, containment procedure documentation, and post-incident reporting. Based on NIST SP 800-61 incident handling guidelines.

projects.name: Network Monitoring Dashboard
projects.description: Lightweight internal tool to monitor host availability and log status changes. Generates periodic reports from SNMP polling and outputs structured summaries. Designed for small-network IT visibility without commercial tooling overhead.
